scope: Strang simulator reference check only; no likelihood, gradient, IF2, IFAD, ABC fit, or reproduction of the 2019 estimation experiment.
covariance_note: Native uses stable Van Loan moments. Author closed-form covariance has small-step cancellation; common-additive-noise tests separate that rounding from the state update. The linear-substep covariance is not the final nonlinear-step covariance.
